description: This file contains unit tests (using Swift's testing frameworks) for the OnboardingView component of an application, specifically testing the UI build process, page order logic, and remote gateway selection behavior.

classes.name: OnboardingViewSmokeTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the OnboardingView component.

methods.name: `onboarding view builds body`
methods.description: Tests that the OnboardingView can build its body without error.

methods.name: `page order omits workspace and identity steps`
methods.description: Verifies that certain pages are omitted based on conditions.

methods.name: `page order omits onboarding chat when identity known`
methods.description: Checks that onboarding chat page is omitted if identity is known.

methods.name: `select remote gateway clears stale ssh target when endpoint unresolved`
methods.description: Ensures selecting a gateway resets the remote target if the endpoint is unresolved.
